baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-6 join the truthful making of the messenger's dream to truth; words 7-18 spell out the future scene that will verify it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dream is joined to truth as correspondence and to truthfulness as fulfillment in action. Its accuracy is therefore performative: the pictured entry becomes the act that verifies the vision, while the divine-will clause leaves its timing under divine agency rather than making truth mean immediacy.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes fulfillment of a promise or vision in action and makes enactment, not bare prediction, the test of truth.
The branch fixes the initial object as a dream image whose later embodiment requires explanation.
The branch supplies stable correspondence with reality and constrains the enactment to remain answerable to the pictured scene.
The branch supplies effective willing and keeps the promised realization dependent on divine choice of occasion.

changed_reading.before: A dream correctly predicts a later entry.
changed_reading.after: The dream is a promise whose truth is completed by enactment; exact realization is firm while its route and occasion remain divinely chosen.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 19-28 move from unequal knowledge to divine making, then to something short of the named goal: a near opening.
baseline_models.mechanism: The knowledge contrast licenses a route unavailable to the audience. Divine making turns what is short of the ultimate entry into a first opening: close enough to belong to fulfillment, yet positioned as a beginning that opens what follows. This permits both a compensatory and a preparatory reading without collapsing them.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes disclosure to one knower and non-disclosure to another, grounding the asymmetry that motivates an indirect route.
The branch contributes active transformation into a new state, so the nearer event is made to function as a stage rather than merely noticed.
The branch supplies proximity that remains short of the goal and gives the interim event its precise spatial-temporal relation to entry.
The branch contributes a beginning that opens what follows, making the near opening a threshold event.
The branch contributes temporal nearness and makes staged fulfillment imminent rather than indefinite.

changed_reading.before: An unforeseen success happens before the promised entry.
changed_reading.after: Hidden knowledge produces a deliberately proximal first opening that can compensate for delay and also begin the route to the promised entry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 7-18 combine entry into the sanctuary with security, altered heads, and negated fear.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entry crosses into a place defined by protected restriction, and the entrants undergo visible bodily reduction while secure. The scene therefore stages vulnerability inside a binding sanctuary: safety does not remove exposure but changes exposure from coerced loss into a completed rite.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies literal passage from outside to inside and makes threshold crossing the mechanism's spatial spine.
The branch identifies the destination as a place of prostration and turns entry into ritual placement rather than generic access.
The branch contributes bounded sanctuary space whose protection depends on its special restriction.
The branch supplies settled inner security and makes safe entry both an external condition and a condition of the heart.
The branch supplies complete removal of hair as one visible mode of ritual bodily change.
The branch localizes the transformation at the exposed uppermost part of the body.
The branch supplies deliberate reduction short of full extent as the alternate bodily mode.
The branch supplies anticipation of harm, whose negation lets bodily exposure occur without threat.

changed_reading.before: The verse pictures a safe pilgrimage and its ordinary hair rite.
changed_reading.after: The promised entry is a protected threshold where visible bodily vulnerability is converted from threatened loss into freely completed ritual action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired hair states in words 14-16 and the near-but-short-of wording in words 25-28 both place full and partial completion inside one promise.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse admits two bodily degrees, full removal and shortening, then names an opening that is close to but short of the final goal. The repeated calibration suggests that truthful fulfillment can arrive in graded forms without becoming false: a partial form can be licensed as a real stage rather than dismissed as failure.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes the complete bodily operation that establishes one end of the calibration.
The branch contributes reduction short of full extent and supplies the partial but valid counterpart.
The branch contributes a stage close to yet below the final goal and transfers calibration from body to timeline.
The branch makes the partial temporal stage a genuine beginning rather than an inert substitute.

changed_reading.before: Shaving or shortening are incidental alternatives, and the near opening is merely another event.
changed_reading.after: The bodily alternatives provide a micro-pattern for graded fulfillment: a short-of-final opening can still be an authentic first completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The clear opening at 48:1 and the promise-hastening-sign sequence at 48:20 activate the focus's near opening as an advance fulfillment that also interprets the delay. It is not only compensation before entry; it is observable evidence that the still-unseen promise is already opening.

activation_trace.role: The branch keeps the opening short of the final goal while allowing it to remain genuinely close to that goal.
The branch contributes an initiating opening and lets the interim event begin the fulfillment process.
The repeated root contributes victory as an opened condition and gives the focus's nearer opening a concrete success register.
The branch contributes emergence into visibility, making an opening capable of disclosing what a delayed promise means.
The branch contributes a spoken promise that opens hope toward a future object and supplies the larger horizon.
The branch contributes bringing one item forward in time and marks it as an advance portion.
The branch contributes a visible sign and turns the hastened event into evidence for what remains future.

structural_cues: 48:1 repeats F-T-H and immediately qualifies the opening as manifest.
48:20 orders promise, a hastened present item, sign, and guidance; 48:27 orders hidden knowledge, divine making, and a near opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opening made manifest and a promised plurality from which one item is hastened as a sign. I infer that the near opening in 48:27 performs the same evidentiary-installment function; the live alternative is a separate compensation with no causal role in final entry.

changed_reading.before: The near opening is a separate success granted while entry is postponed.
changed_reading.after: The near opening is both success and advance sign: it makes delayed fulfillment partially visible and begins what the dream promises.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bad forecast that the messenger and believers would never return supplies a rival future image to the truthful dream. Its circular consequence turns prediction into a self-enclosing defeat model. The focus's truth, knowledge contrast, and negated fear therefore also repair how uncertain futures are read, not only announce an outcome.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the positive future image that competes with the context's failed forecast.
The branch makes enacted fulfillment the eventual correction to premature inference.
The branch contributes anticipated harm, so its negation includes release from the failed forecast's affective grip.
The branch contributes an outcome whose end cannot be trusted, exposing the rival forecast as epistemically unstable.
The branch contributes reversal across both the predicted non-return and the hearts that host the prediction, enabling an epistemic turn.
The branch contributes the enclosing circuit of expected defeat and supplies the negative model that the dream breaks.

structural_cues: 48:12 explicitly predicts that the messenger and believers will never return to their people, while 48:27 promises entry without fear.
The context repeats bad supposition before the focus contrasts divine knowledge with human non-knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two incompatible future construals, one condemned and one made true in action. I infer that the focus retrains expectation by allowing delay without conceding the bad forecast; the live alternative is that the passages only classify opposing groups and do not describe an epistemic process.

changed_reading.before: The truthful dream replaces one incorrect prediction with a correct prediction.
changed_reading.after: The dream interrupts a self-confirming forecast of non-return: delayed evidence must be reread through enacted signs rather than converted into fear or certainty of failure.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 48:18, knowledge of hearts leads into bestowed stillness and then the exact near-opening collocation. This activates the focus's near opening as an exterior success inseparable from an interior unlocking: settled hearts are part of how the delayed route becomes traversable.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes settled inner security and anchors the affective dimension in the promised entry itself.
The branch contributes relief or insight as release from inward closure and preserves a non-spatial dimension of opening.
The branch contributes divine disclosure of what is in hearts and initiates the contextual sequence.
The branch contributes consoling stillness and makes interior settling an operative gift rather than passive mood.
The branch lets the named opening carry relief and cognitive unblocking alongside external success.
The branch reproduces nearness and tightly couples the interior sequence to the focus's interim event.

structural_cues: 48:18 runs from knowledge of hearts to descent of tranquility to reward with a near opening.
48:18 and 48:27 repeat the F-T-H plus Q-R-B collocation, while 48:27 also names security and non-fear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a local sequence from known hearts through tranquility to near opening. I infer that interior settling enables or constitutes one layer of that opening; the live alternative is that tranquility and victory are adjacent rewards with no directional relation.

changed_reading.before: The near opening is an external political or spatial event.
changed_reading.after: The near opening can remain external while also naming release from inward closure, with settled hearts making safe entry possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated restraint of hands, culminating in mutual restraint inside Mecca after capacity for victory, gives the focus's security a concrete mechanism. Safety is not simply danger disappearing; it is power held from contact on both sides at the threshold.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes settled confidence as the human outcome of controlled contact.
The branch supplies expected harm, whose negation requires a mechanism stronger than mere optimism.
The branch contributes active prevention of hands and first supplies restraint as protection.
The branch contributes reciprocal prevention and turns non-contact into a deliberately produced condition.
The branch locates restraint inside the city's interior, directly activating the focus's promised crossing into sanctuary space.
The branch contributes achieved superiority and shows that restraint persists despite capacity to press advantage.

structural_cues: 48:20 restrains people's hands from the believers; 48:24 restrains each side's hands from the other.
48:24 places mutual restraint inside Mecca after victory, immediately before the blocked-sanctuary scene of 48:25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal hand restraint in the city's interior after advantage is available. I infer that such inhibited force produces the safety pictured in 48:27; the live alternative is that restraint only describes an earlier episode and security belongs solely to the future sanctuary status.

changed_reading.before: The entrants are safe because opposition has ceased or been defeated.
changed_reading.after: The entrants are safe through reciprocal restraint: capacity remains, but hands are actively prevented from turning proximity into harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inaccessible 'other' at 48:21 is beyond present human capacity yet already comprehended and preserved by divine enclosure. This sharpens the focus's knowledge gap: delay need not mean an absent future, but a future held whole outside current reach while a nearer opening is supplied.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the unequal disclosure that separates divine possession of the route from human access to it.
The branch gives humans a proximal stage while the farther object remains outside present reach.
The branch contributes effective capacity and contrasts current human inability with unrestricted divine capability.
The branch contributes complete enclosure in knowledge and possession, keeping the unavailable future from being read as lost.

structural_cues: 48:21 contrasts what the audience cannot presently attain with what God has already encompassed.
48:27 contrasts what God knows with what the audience does not know and then supplies a nearer event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel asymmetries of capacity and knowledge. I infer that divine encompassing holds the deferred object intact while the near opening mediates human limitation; the live alternative is that 48:21's other object is unrelated to the dreamed entry.

changed_reading.before: The promised goal is delayed because circumstances have not yet produced it.
changed_reading.after: The deferred goal can be already held whole in divine knowledge and control while remaining beyond human capacity, with the near opening bridging that asymmetry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The blocked sanctuary at 48:25 contains unrecognized believers intermingled with opponents; immediate advance risks trampling them and acquiring an unseen stain. The counterfactual separation activates the focus's knowledge gap as protective rerouting: delay preserves hidden lives, and the near opening is made on the safe side of that obstruction.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes the focus's explicit contrast between disclosed and undisclosed realities.
The branch contributes deliberate conversion of the blocked route into a different near opening.
The branch contributes active diversion from the sanctuary and supplies the obstacle requiring another route.
The branch contributes detention of the offering and materializes suspended arrival at the threshold.
The branch contributes specifically unrecognized persons and action without knowledge, filling the focus's knowledge gap with a live protective possibility.
The branch contributes crushing pressure and makes immediate entry capable of harming the hidden people it seeks to join.
The branch contributes a contaminating stain of harm and gives the unknown collision a social and moral consequence.
The branch contributes separation and discrimination, whose explicit absence explains why force cannot yet be cleanly directed.

structural_cues: 48:25 repeats the focus's mosque and sanctuary destination but places obstruction, a detained offering, and unknown believers before it.
The verse makes punitive action conditional on prior separation; without separation, advance risks ignorant injury.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden intermixture, risk of trampling without knowledge, and a separation counterfactual. I infer that this concealed human topology is a cause of deferment and of the substituted near opening; the live alternative is that 'what you did not know' is broader and that the opening's identity is independent of this protection.

changed_reading.before: Unknown strategic circumstances cause the promised entry to be postponed.
changed_reading.after: The delay can be a rescue operation: divine knowledge reroutes fulfillment around intermingled, unseen people whom immediate success would crush or stain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, heated group pride is answered by bestowed stillness and attachment to a protective word. That sequence activates the shaved or shortened heads as more than destination markers: the altered head can stage relinquished aggressive self-protection, a public vulnerability made possible by disciplined calm.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes visible removal of hair and supplies the bodily exposure that the context can recode.
The branch locates the rite at the body's top, allowing a restrained posture to become publicly legible.
The branch contributes calm confidence as the condition under which exposure ceases to be humiliating danger.
The branch contributes heated pride and anger as the embodied force that must be cooled rather than mirrored.
The branch contributes unstable temper and makes the conflict a problem of disposition as well as information.
The branch contributes cessation of reactive motion and provides the counterforce to heated pride.
The branch contributes binding attachment to a rule and turns calm into durable discipline.
The branch contributes prevention of harm and makes disciplined restraint a form of protection.

structural_cues: 48:26 immediately precedes the focus and sequences heated pride, ignorance, descended stillness, and a binding protective word.
48:27 then pictures secure entrants with visibly altered heads and no fear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a de-escalation sequence followed by secure bodily exposure. I infer that the hair rite can embody relinquished aggressive self-protection; the materially live alternative is that shaving and shortening remain only standard ritual identifiers with no symbolic causal role.

changed_reading.before: Shaved and shortened heads simply certify completion of the destination rite.
changed_reading.after: They can also stage de-escalated power: disciplined calm makes the exposed head a sign of secure restraint rather than defeat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's private dream belongs to a messenger whose truth is to become visible action. At 48:28, sending, truth, manifestation, and witness form a public-verification chain. The dreamed entry can therefore be a local prototype of a wider movement from carried report to witnessed reality.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the initially private dream whose public status is at issue.
The branch contributes a bearer of a carried message and connects the dream to communicative office.
The branch contributes establishment and display of truth, preparing the move from private vision to public proof.
The branch contributes sending forth and gives public movement to what the messenger carries.
The branch contributes truth established by being brought to appearance and links mission to verification.
The branch contributes emergence and disclosure, making manifestation the direction of the mission.
The branch contributes presence with seeing and closes the chain in public witness rather than private assertion.

structural_cues: 48:27 moves from the messenger's dream to its specified visible enactment.
48:28 repeats messenger and truth, adds making-visible language, and ends with witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical chain from sending through truth to manifestation and witness. I infer that the entry scene is one bounded demonstration of that larger public-verification process; the live alternative is that 48:28 concerns a wider mission without retroactively changing the dream's function.

changed_reading.before: The dream is privately validated when the predicted event occurs.
changed_reading.after: The dream's enacted scene is a public proof-event: a carried report crosses into witnessed reality and prototypes a wider manifestation of truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing plant sequence moves from shoot to mutual support, thickening, and stable standing. Read back into the focus's near-but-not-final opening, it offers an organic model of fulfillment: an intermediate event can be the shoot whose growth changes the capacity for final entry, not merely a consolation unrelated to it.

activation_trace.role: The branch supplies the near stage short of maturity and gives the growth sequence a temporal anchor in the focus.
The branch contributes a beginning that opens later development, functioning like emergence of a first shoot.
The branch contributes temporal imminence without claiming that the process has reached its mature end.
The branch contributes germination and development as the context's explicit process model.
The branch contributes a new shoot emerging around the origin and supplies an image for an early but real fulfillment.
The branch contributes strengthening through mutual support and gives the intermediate stage causal force.
The branch contributes thickening after thinness and marks increased capacity over time.
The branch contributes achieved integrity and maturity as the process's later stable state.

structural_cues: 48:29 presents a strict verbal sequence: shoot emerges, supports, thickens, and stands complete.
48:27 similarly places a made near opening before realization of the fully pictured entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a growth analogy explicitly scoped to the community. I infer that its ordered development can also pattern the focus's fulfillment timeline; the live alternative is that the analogy describes communal character only and should not be transferred to event sequence.

changed_reading.before: The near opening compensates for a final event that has not happened yet.
changed_reading.after: The near opening can be formative growth: an early emergence that strengthens the community's capacity for the later entry it does not yet equal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the less direct diminution branch of fear rather than its ordinary affective sense. It remains anchored in the immediate juxtaposition of shaving or shortening with negated fear and distinguishes chosen ritual subtraction from harmful loss. Render it as a lexical paradox layered under the ordinary meaning, never as a replacement translation of 'you will not fear.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 14-18 place voluntary removal or shortening directly before the negation of a root that can also image diminution.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes complete chosen removal and establishes intentional subtraction.
The branch contributes chosen reduction short of full extent as the second controlled mode.
The branch contributes involuntary diminution, whose negation separates ritual reduction from damaging loss.

changed_reading.before: The entrants alter their hair and feel no fear.
changed_reading.after: They accept a bounded, chosen reduction while being protected from coercive diminution: surrender of hair is not surrender to harm.

It remains valid as a secondary activation because the focus names a dream communicated by a messenger, while the context supplies a visible sign and durable marks. Render it as a hypothesis about the dream's social afterlife, not as an etymological replacement for the dream noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The messenger's dream in words 4-6 is communicated and then specified as a publicly recognizable scene.

activation_trace.role: The split branch contributes transmission of report and activates the dream as something carried through communal narration.
The branch contributes a visible sign by which the communicated promise can gather credibility before final fulfillment.
The branch contributes a recognizable outward mark and extends verification into communal visibility.
The branch contributes a lasting trace that points back to prior action, giving public memory an evidentiary surface.

changed_reading.before: The dream remains private information until the predicted scene occurs.
changed_reading.after: Once carried as report, the dream can function socially as an accumulating sign whose credibility grows through visible partial traces.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the ring branch behind the shaving root and links it to the context's explicit circle of defeat. It remains anchored in the focus's shaved entrants, opening, and non-fear, but the connection is imagistic rather than syntactic. Render it only as a secondary reversal image: a harmful enclosing circuit is answered by a freely completed ritual circuit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 14-18 join the H-L-Q form to secure non-fear, while word 27 names an opening of what had been closed.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes ring and circulation as a latent shape under the surface shaving form.
The branch contributes release of closure and supplies the transition out of an enclosing harmful circuit.
The branch contributes the hostile circle of reversal or defeat that the secure ritual image can invert.

changed_reading.before: The shaved entrants simply complete a rite after a hostile cycle ends.
changed_reading.after: At an imagistic level, the rite converts enclosure into completion: the circle of defeat is opened and re-formed as a voluntary ritual circuit without fear.

strongest_changes: The near opening becomes an advance sign that both grants success and makes delayed fulfillment legible.
Hidden intermixture at the blocked sanctuary supplies a protective reason for rerouting rather than forcing immediate entry.
Reciprocal restraint of hands gives security a concrete mechanism even when power and proximity remain.
Knowledge of hearts and bestowed stillness preserve an interior-opening layer alongside political and spatial readings.
The private dream can move toward public witness, while the closing growth sequence keeps organic, staged fulfillment live.
summary.what_was_special: The focus does not merely reconcile a true dream with delay. Its branch structure repeatedly turns partiality into live process: short-of-final can be an authentic beginning, withheld force can produce safety, hidden people can redirect victory, and visible bodily states can carry both ritual completion and disciplined vulnerability. These mechanisms coexist rather than selecting a single referent for the near opening.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact historical or spatial identity of the near opening remains unspecified by the hermetic packet and should not be collapsed to one event.
The causal arrow from hidden intermixture to the substituted opening is strongly invited by sequence but remains a reader inference.
The de-escalatory symbolism of shaved or shortened heads is plausible but more exploratory than their direct ritual function.
The R-W-Y carried-report and circle-reversal outliers depend on form-distant branch activation and should remain explicitly secondary.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Truthful fulfillment can include delay.** `صدق` anchors ص د ق B001 (truth in speech) and B004 (confirmation/fulfillment); `الرؤيا` anchors ر ء ي B003 (dream vision); `الحق` anchors ح ق ق B001/B005. Entry is emphatically future, while prior restraint and unknown facts explain non-immediacy. I infer that truth governs outcome without requiring the audience’s timetable. Delay corrects, rather than falsifies, the vision.
2. **Secure entry becomes bodily legible.** `آمنين` anchors ء م ن B001 (security); `محلقين` anchors ح ل ق B002 (shaving), `رؤوسكم` ر ء س B001, and `مقصرين` ق ص ر B003 (shortening by omission). These visible ritual alternatives stand beside `لا تخافون`, خ و ف B001. I infer that removed fear permits the promised state to be inscribed on bodies. Security is enacted, not merely inward.
3. **A near opening lies short of the final limit.** `من دون ذلك` anchors د و ن B001 (nearness short of a limit) and B003 (other than/besides); `فتحًا قريبًا` anchors ف ت ح B001/B004 and ق ر ب B001/B002. I infer that an intermediate opening can be both other than and near the promised entry. The phrase preserves two stages without treating the first as failure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 48:28 recasts the staged fulfillment as manifestation of true guidance, and 48:29 makes that manifestation bodily and social. The near opening is part of an evidentiary sequence, not merely an interim prize.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Truth fulfilled through an intermediate threshold.** Fixed `صَدَقَ` anchors ص د ق `B004`, confirmation and fulfilment; `ٱلرُّؤْيَا` anchors ر ء ي `B003`, dream vision; `ٱلْحَقّ` anchors ح ق ق `B001`, firm truth. Yet fixed `مِن دُونِ ذَلِكَ` activates د و ن `B001`, nearness short of a limit, and `قَرِيبًا` anchors ق ر ب `B001`, nearness. Ayat 48:24-25 supply restraint and delayed entry; I infer **truthful destination -> nearer opening short of that limit -> staged fulfilment rather than replacement**. Confirmation need not collapse all promised phases into one moment.

2. **A secured threshold passage marked on bodies.** Fixed `ءَامِنِين` anchors ء م ن `B001`, settled security; `مُحَلِّقِين` anchors ح ل ق `B002`, shaving and removing hair; `مُقَصِّرِين` anchors ق ص ر `B003`, shortening by removing part. Ayah 48:29 later makes a bodily sign and prostration-trace diagnostic. The packet supplies safe entry plus two regulated bodily alterations; I infer **completed protected passage -> visible, disciplined threshold state**. Shaving and shortening read as embodied evidence of arrival under security, not incidental description.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 48:28 recast the near opening as one stage in a larger manifestation rather than a substitute for the vision. Ayah 48:29 then confirmed the bodily-evidence reading through visible faces, prostration-trace, and a growth sequence reaching stable support.

baseline.text: Allah elçisine rüyayı kesinlikle doğru gösterdi: Allah dilerse Mescid-i Haram'a güven içinde, başlarınızı tıraş etmiş veya saçlarınızı kısaltmış olarak, korkmadan mutlaka gireceksiniz. Allah sizin bilmediğinizi bildi ve bundan önce yakın bir fetih verdi.

findings.text: Rüyanın doğrulanması, hedefin tek anda gerçekleşmesini gerektirmez; son sınıra varmadan verilen yakın açılış, doğru vaadin aşamalı yerine gelişidir.
Güvenli geçiş, korkunun yokluğunu tıraş ve saç kısaltma gibi düzenli beden işaretleriyle görünür kılan tamamlanmış bir eşik hâlidir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Regulation at the Sacred Threshold
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Entry into sacred space is governed by boundaries, detained offerings, arrival at an appointed place, and release from a prior bodily state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The sanctuary is not a simple inside/outside division; it is a regulated threshold where bodies and offerings undergo different authorization sequences.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Authorized Entry Changes Bodily State
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Protected entrants cross the boundary and display release from consecration by shaving or shortening the hair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); consecrated ritual state (`quranic:root_000313:B004/m01`); dissolution of prohibition (`quranic:root_000351:B003/m01`); shaving (`quranic:root_000350:B002/m01`); shortening hair (`quranic:root_001231:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:27 `لتدخلن`, `المسجد الحرام`, `محلقين`, and `مقصرين` (د خ ل; ح ر م; ح ل ق; ق ص ر); 48:25 `محله` (ح ل ل).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Entry and bodily alteration are coordinated threshold events. Crossing the sacred boundary is completed by visible release from the prior ritual state, with shaving and shortening marking two authorized forms of that transition.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Vision Verified as Access and Manifestation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What is first represented becomes true by turning into traversable access and then public appearance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Verification is not limited to correspondence between dream and event; it progressively unblocks a threshold and makes guidance publicly ascendant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Seen Promise Is Made True
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A represented scene is shown, tested against truth, and fulfilled as an actual event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dream (`quranic:root_000531:B003/m01`); making visible (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); fulfilling or verifying a dream (`quranic:root_000852:B004/m01`); truth (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); establishing or showing truth (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:27 `صدق`, `الرؤيا`, and `بالحق` (ص د ق; ر ء ي; ح ق ق).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The vision begins as a represented scene, but truth acts on it as verification. Fulfillment converts visibility from an inward image into an event whose correspondence can be publicly established.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2: Vision Verified as Access and Manifestation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What is first represented becomes true by turning into traversable access and then public appearance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Verification is not limited to correspondence between dream and event; it progressively unblocks a threshold and makes guidance publicly ascendant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Threshold Becomes Near and Traversable
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Obstruction is removed, an opening approaches, and protected bodies pass through the threshold.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: opened threshold (`quranic:root_001124:B001/m01`); insight or unblocking (`quranic:root_001124:B008/m01`); entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`); event becoming due or close (`quranic:root_001212:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 48:27 `لتدخلن`, `قريبا`, and `فتحا` (د خ ل; ق ر ب; ف ت ح).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The opening is the operational form of verification: it removes the obstruction that separates image from traversal. Nearness compresses the interval until entry becomes possible.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı yalanın karşıtı olan söz doğruluğu olarak kurar ve daha özel olarak sözün hem konuşanın iç inancına hem de anlattığı gerçeğe uymasını ister. Bu nedenle dal, genel doğruluk kavramına genişletilmeden söz ve bildirim alanında tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, arkadaşlık, maddi verme, evlilik hakkı ve nesnelerin fiziksel sağlamlığıyla ilgili kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimdeki söz doğruluğunu temel alır; konuşmada doğruyu söyleme ve bir sözün doğruluğunu kabul etme gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımları ayrıca sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözün yalan olmaması ve hem söyleyenin iç inancıyla hem de hakkında konuşulan gerçekle uyuşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Söylenen söz yalanın karşıtıdır ve gerçeği bildirir.
Tam uygunluk, sözün hem konuşanın iç inancıyla hem de bildirilen durumla uyuşmasını gerektirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, söz doğruluğunu yalanın karşıtı sayar; ayrıntılı açıklama, söz ile iç inanç ve dış gerçeklik arasında birlikte uygunluk arar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Söz doğruluğunun hem içtenlik hem de gerçekliğe uygunluk koşulunu birlikte anlatan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözün yalandan uzak olmasını ve iki yönlü uygunluk koşulunu birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam yalnızca yalan söylememeyi veya gerçeği bildirmeyi öne çıkardığında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yalanın karşıtı olan doğru söyleme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Sözün hem iç inançla hem de dış gerçeklikle birlikte uyuşması koşulunu açıkça taşımaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Konuşanın inancı ile anlattığı durum arasındaki iki yönlü uygunluğun açıklanması gereken bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İçtenlik ile dış gerçeğe uygunluğu aynı söz eyleminde birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi fiziksel bir şey için sertlik ve düz ya da düzgün olma niteliklerini açıkça birlikte verir; mızrak örneği de bu somut nitelemeyi destekler. Dalın fiziksel güç ve biçim düzgünlüğü çerçevesi bu kanıtla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal söz doğruluğunu veya ahlaki güvenilirliği değil, bir nesnenin somut sertlik ve düzgünlük niteliğini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın nitelik sertlik ya da düzgünlük olarak tanımlanır; nesne ve mızrakla kurulan niteleme örnekleri yalnızca bu fiziksel anlamın yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin fiziksel olarak sert ve dayanıklı ya da biçim bakımından düz ve düzgün olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Nesne fiziksel sertlik ve sağlamlık taşır.
Nitelik, biçim bakımından düz veya düzgün olmayı da anlatabilir.
Sert ve güçlü bir mızrak bu fiziksel niteliğin örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, fiziksel nesneyi sert ve sağlam diye niteler; bazı aktarımlar buna düz veya düzgün olma yönünü de ekler ve mızrağı örnek verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel sertlik ile düz ve düzgün biçim seçeneklerini tek üst karşılıkta koruyan kullanımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Sertlik ve düzgünlük yönlerini alternatif fiziksel nitelikler olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam bir nesnenin direncini veya bir mızrağın fiziksel gücünü öne çıkardığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel sertlik, sağlamlık ve güç yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Düz veya düzgün biçimli olma seçeneğini karşılamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bağlam sertlikten çok nesnenin biçimsel düzgünlüğünü belirginleştirdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Biçim bakımından düz ve düzgün olma yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Nesnenin sertlik ve dayanıklılık niteliğini karşılamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sert ve güçlü nesne ya da mızrak

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak somut nesnenin sertliği veya düzgünlüğüyle sınırlıdır; komşu hem somut hem de soyut güç ve şiddet durumlarını kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak nesnenin olumlu sertlik veya düzgünlük niteliğini doğrudan belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu yalnızca yayın gövdesinde yarık bulunmaması ve yayın çatlamaması durumunu belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da fiziksel bir nesnenin bütünlüğü ve dayanıklılığı alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak genel bir fiziksel niteliktir; komşu belirli bir nesnenin belirli kusurdan yoksun oluşunu anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi insan nitelemelerini, herhangi bir şeyde tamlık fikrini ve övgüye uygun sağlam durum bildiren bir dizi kullanımı aynı dalda toplar. Verilen tam iyilik ve kalıcılık çerçevesi, bu kullanımları söz doğruluğuna indirgemeden bir arada tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yalnızca doğru haber vermeyi değil; bir kişi, şey veya durumdaki tamlık, iyilik, güvenilirlik ve övgüye değer sağlamlığı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimdeki tamlık anlamı korunur; kişi nitelemeleri ile yer, öncelik, giriş, çıkış ve anılma alanındaki yapıya bağlı övgü kullanımları ayrı yüzler olarak gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi, şey veya durumun iyi, güvenilir ve övgüye değer sayılacak ölçüde tam ve sağlam olmasıdır. Kişi nitelemelerinde erdem ve güvenilirlik, belirli yapılarda ise kalıcı ve övülebilir bir durum öne çıkar.

facets.statement: Bir şey kendi türü içinde tamlığa ve kusursuzluğa erişmiştir.
İnsan nitelemesinde iyilik, erdem, sağlam karakter ve güvenilirlik öne çıkar.
Yer, öncelik, giriş, çıkış veya anılma gibi alanlarda durumun iyi, sağlam ve sonradan övülmeye elverişli oluşunu belirtir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, tamlığı genel çekirdek olarak verir; insanları iyilik ve güvenilirlikle niteler, belirli durumları da doğru biçimde övülmeye elverişli sağlamlıkları bakımından değerlendirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Şeylerdeki kusursuzluğu, kişilerdeki erdemi ve durumlarda övgüye değer sağlamlığı birlikte temsil eden üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Tamlık çekirdeğini, olumlu değerlemeyi ve güvenilir sağlamlık yönünü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya topluluğun erdem, sağlam karakter ve güvenilirlik bakımından övüldüğü bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsan nitelemesindeki iyilik ve güvenilirlik yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Şeylerdeki genel tamlığı ve durumlara bağlı övgü kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yerin, başlangıcın, girişin, çıkışın veya kalıcı anılmanın iyi ve övgüye uygun niteliği anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Durumun iyi, sağlam ve sonradan övülmeye elverişli oluşunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişi nitelemesini ve her şeydeki yalın tamlık anlamını kapsamaz.

övülmeye değer, iyi ve sağlam durum

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca vaat veya savaşta gereğini yapmayı değil, bir tahmini gerçekleştirmeyi, bir sözü onaylamayı ve önceki bir bildiriyi destekleyip doğrulamayı da kapsar. Bu nedenle dal, salt vaat yerine getirme olarak değil; söz, beklenti veya iddiayı gerçekleşme, eylem ya da onayla doğrulama alanı olarak yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Fiilî yerine getirme çekirdeğin önemli bir görünümüdür; ancak gerçekleşen tahmin ve doğrulayıcı onay da dalın sınırı içinde kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak doğrulama ve gerçekleştirme çekirdeğini verir; savaş, tahmin, önceki bildiri ve konuşmayı onaylama anlamlarını yalnızca kendi yapılarında geçerli uzmanlaşmalar olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir söz, beklenti, vaat veya iddiayı gerçekleşme, eylem ya da onay yoluyla doğru çıkarmak ve gerektiğinde söyleneni fiilen yerine getirmektir. Savaşta gereğini yapma, tahminin gerçekleşmesi ve önceki bir bildiriyi destekleme bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Bir söz, beklenti veya iddia gerçekleşme, eylem ya da onayla doğru çıkarılır.
Savaş bağlamında kişi gereğini yerine getirir, sebat eder ve eylemiyle sözünün hakkını verir.
Bir tahminin veya beklentinin doğru çıkması da gerçekleşme yoluyla doğrulamadır.
Bir sözün doğruluğunu kabul etmek veya önceki bir bildiriyi desteklemek onay yoluyla doğrulamadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, bir söz veya beklentinin eylemle, gerçekleşmeyle ya da onayla doğrulanmasıdır; savaşta gereğini yapma, tahminin çıkması ve önceki bildiriyi destekleme bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylemle yerine getirme, beklentinin çıkması ve bir bildiriyi onaylama yollarını ortak doğrulama çekirdeğinde birleştirir.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçekleştirme, fiilen yerine getirme ve onayla doğrulama yollarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kimsenin vaat ettiğini veya üstlendiğini fiilen yerine getirdiği, özellikle mücadelede gereğini yaptığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi arkadaşlığı içten ve doğru sevgiye dayandırır, arkadaş olma ve yakın dostluk anlamlarını açıkça bir araya getirir. Verilen çerçeve, yalnızca doğru sözlü kişi anlamını dışarıda bıraktığı için dal sınırını da doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki doğruluk, haberin gerçekliğinden çok sevgi, bağlılık ve iyi niyetin içtenliğini niteler.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın arkadaşlık ve dost olma alanını tanımlar; başka dallardaki söz doğruluğu, maddi verme veya özel yapılara bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

facets.statement: İki kişi arasındaki yakınlık, içten ve doğru bir sevgi inancına dayanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iyilik amacıyla maldan çıkarılan yardımı, kişinin bir hakkından vazgeçmesini, yardımı vereni ve hayvanlara ilişkin payları toplayan görevliyi kapsar. Geçici çerçevenin her türlü zorunlu hakkı niyet koşuluyla bu dala katması kanıtta açık değildir; tanım, mali yardım ve haktan bağışlayarak vazgeçme çekirdeğiyle sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Veren ve toplayan kişi adları çekirdeğin katılımcı türevleridir; evlilikte kadına verilen özel mal ve genel yoksulluk bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın mali yardım anlamı temel alınır; bir haktan vazgeçme yapısı ile veren ve toplayan kişi adları ayrı, yapıya bağlı yüzler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin iyilik ve manevi yakınlaşma amacıyla malından çıkarıp verdiği yardım veya kendi hakkından bağışlayarak vazgeçmesidir. Alan ayrıca yardımı veren kişiyi ve hayvanlara ilişkin yardım paylarını toplayan görevliyi belirten türev kullanımları kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişi kendi malından iyilik ve manevi yakınlaşma amacıyla bir pay çıkarıp verir.
Kişinin kendi hakkından bağışlayarak vazgeçmesi de mali yardım gibi değerlendirilir.
Yardımı veren kimse, verme eylemindeki katılımcı olarak ayrıca adlandırılır.
Hayvanlara ilişkin yardım paylarını alan veya toplayan görevli, verme eyleminden farklı bir katılımcıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt maldan iyilik amacıyla verilen yardımı çekirdek sayar; haktan bağışlayarak vazgeçmeyi buna benzetir ve veren kişiyle hayvan paylarını toplayan görevliyi ayrı katılımcılar olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tapınma eylemini, kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini, bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı ve tapınılan varlığı aynı anlam örgüsü içinde açıkça birleştirir. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ondan türeyen varlık adlarını doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, tapınma eylemi ile bundan türeyen tapınılan veya tapınılır kılınan varlık anlamlarını kapsar; şaşkınlık, yoğun üzüntü ve salt özel ad kullanımları bu sınırın dışındadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın eylem çekirdeğini türemiş eylem ve varlık adlarından ayırır; türemiş biçimlerin kapsamı yalın eylemin tamamına aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, tapınmayı anlamın temeli sayar; kişinin tapınmaya yönelmesini, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınılır kılma işlemini bu temelden türetir. Tapınma konusu sayılan yontular ve güneş örneği, varlık anlamının belirli uygulamalarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Eylem çekirdeğiyle ondan türeyen tapınılan varlık anlamının birlikte temsil edilmesi gereken genel açıklamalarda kullanılır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أله وتأله بمعنى عبد وتنسك، والتأليه بمعنى التعبيد، والإله والآلهة والإلاهة لما جعل معبودا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه أله بمعنى تحير، ولا ألهت على فلان بمعنى اشتد جزعي عليه، ولا أسماء المواضع أو الحية أو الهلال إلا من جهة التسمية لا معنى العبادة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو التعبد، فالإله الله تعالى لأنه معبود، وتأله الرجل إذا تعبد، والإلاهة الشمس سميت بذلك لأن قوما كانوا يعبدونها (maqayis)؛ التأله التعبد (ayn)؛ أله بالفتح إلاهة أي عبد عبادة، مألوه أي معبود، الآلهة الأصنام، التأليه التعبيد، التأله التنسك والتعبد (sihah)؛ لا يكون إلاها حتى يكون معبودا، معبوداتهم من الأصنام والأوثان آلهة، الإلاهة الشمس، وإلاهتك وعبادتك (tahdhib)؛ إله اسما لكل معبود، أله فلان يأله الآلهة عبد، فالإله على هذا هو المعبود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini, genel tapınılan-varlık adından türetiliş açıklamasını ve bu özel adla kurulan seslenme ile ant biçimlerini birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak dal yalnızca seslenme ve ant kalıpları değildir; özel adın yalın kullanımı da çekirdekte tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, özel ad ile bu ada bağlı seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimleriyle sınırlıdır; herhangi bir tapınılan varlığı gösteren genel ad anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın özel ad, doğrudan seslenme biçimleri ve ant ya da şaşma kalıpları ayrı tutulur; kalıplara özgü işlevler özel adın her kullanımına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Yaratıcıya özgü adın kendisini ve bu adla kurulan seslenme, dilek, şaşma ve ant biçimlerini kapsar. Bu biçimler doğrudan seslenme, adın ant değeriyle kullanılması veya ses ve parçaların düşürülmesiyle kısaltılma yollarını gösterir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.
Özel adın, tapınılan varlığı bildiren genel addan ses düşmesi ve belirleyici unsur eklenmesiyle oluştuğu açıklanır.
Özel ad, sözün başında ant değeri taşıyarak ardından gelen yapmama bildirimini güçlendirebilir.
Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin iç dünyasının birine veya bir şeye yönelmesini; yabancılık duygusunun kalkıp güven, rahatlık ve açıklık doğmasını anlatır. Çerçeve bu iç yöneliş ile dışa açılma sonucunu doğru bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi karşılıklı haberleşmeyi, atışma gibi bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte öncekinin ardından gitmeyi aynı karşılıklılık ve izleme alanında toplar. Çerçeve bu özel katılımcı rollerini doğru korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım karşılıklı haberleşme, yarışma eşliği ve şarkı ya da işte izleme biçimlerini kendi yapılara bağlı tutar; yalın köke genel arkadaşlık anlamı verilmez.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki taraf arasında karşılıklı gönderim veya birinin ötekini izlemesiyle kurulan eşgüdümdür.
Atışma veya başka bir uğraşta kişinin yanında duran ve onunla birlikte ilerleyen eşlikçi kastedilebilir.
Şarkı veya işte bir öncekinin sesini ya da eylemini izleyerek sürdüren kişi kastedilebilir.
